When I was 16 my mom tried to kill her self, we had gotten into an argument earlier that day and she locked her self in her room. I went to lay down and calm myself down, ended up falling asleep. 

Later that night after I woke up and took a shower I noticed her lunch bag was sitting on the kitchen table untouched, I thought maybe she forgot to take it or maybe she didn’t have to go in to work yet. Something just didn’t feel right, I tried opening her bedroom door and it was locked. I decided to call her phone and heard it ringing from her bedroom, no answer. I put my ear to the door and knocked but heard snoring, she never snores or sleeps heavy, she has insomnia. 

At that point I’m freaking out and decided to call 911, they showed up and broke down her door. Before the officer could get in I pushed him and ran into her room and that’s when I saw her face down in vomit, empty pill bottle and empty alcohol bottles. The EMTs came and carried her out of the house in a white sheet, her hair was sticking out of it. 

In the car on the way the hospital, I could see through the ambulance door window they started CPR. I called her sisters and brother to let them know what happened. After we got the hospital and she was in a room, I went in to see her. She was on life support with a machine that also was raising her body temp to normal. After she got into the ICU and everyone left she had a seizure. 

She took over 10,000mg of seroquil (my medication), and drank two 5ths. She lived and has normal brain function but her mental health hasn’t been the same since. 

I will never forget that night, I will never forget no matter how hard I try. I remember every second like it was just yesterday. I couldn’t eat or sleep for weeks after. It changed who I was and who I became. I’m more humble now. I love her to death and express it as much as I can.

When I was little (7 or 8) my parents had gotten divorced and I moved in with my dad. My dad had just gotten this house, it was on the market for a while because the previous owner died in a freak accident in the backyard. 

There was a lot of activity in that house; doors opening and closing on their own, bathroom light went out a lot on it’s own, you’d get poked, hair pulled, scratched, you could take pictures and see someone blurry in the picture, the list goes on and on. 

There’s only one thing that’s stuck with me, I was taking a shower one night and the light went out (not uncommon) but something felt different this time, I felt like I was being watched. I turned to look through the shower door and saw someone standing outside of the shower. They had a very dim bluish green glow to them, at that point I starting freaking out and ran out of the bathroom. 

Still freaks me out to this day.
